goals.0: Two objects: Ich schenke ihr ein Buch
goals.1: Order of pronouns: Ich gebe es ihr
goals.2: Good wishes: Alles Gute zum Geburtstag
dialog.3.de.2.n: The Akkusativ pronoun comes first: sie (the presents) before ihr
grammar.0.title: Dativ + Akkusativ: who gives whom what?
grammar.0.note: These verbs take two objects: geben, schenken, kaufen, schicken, zeigen, bringen, erklären, empfehlen.
grammar.1.title: Word order: pronouns first, nouns after
grammar.1.note: Rule: a pronoun comes before a noun. When both are pronouns, the Akkusativ comes first (es ihr), then the Dativ. A Dativ noun usually comes before an Akkusativ noun.
grammar.2.title: Good wishes
grammar.2.rows.1.1: on a success, a wedding, an exam
quiz.6.why: The pronoun first, the noun after.
quiz.9.prompt: Put the sentence in order: “We'll give them to her together.”
quiz.9.why: The Akkusativ pronoun (sie) first, then the Dativ (ihr).
